Weekday Dawn Laps in Central Park (NYCC)

New York, NY · Central Park · Road

Weekday Dawn Laps in Central Park (NYCC) is a road group ride in New York, NY. It rolls mondays and Tuesdays and Wednesdays and Thursdays at 6:05 am from Central Park (the public ride page gives no meeting point). About 12–24 miles, lap times from 16:00 (A, about 22 mph) to 29:00 (C, about 12 mph).

Check the host's page before you go

When
Mondays and Tuesdays and Wednesdays and Thursdays, 6:05 amMonday to Thursday before work. Several groups start between 5:40 and 6:50 am, sorted by lap time. A-level laps at 5:40 am on Tuesdays and Thursdays, B-level laps at 6:05 am on Tuesdays and Thursdays, Recovery Laps on Mondays at 6:25 am, a slower C group on Thursdays at 6:45 am. Each ride is two to four laps, 12 to 24 miles.

For visitors

Sign in to the club's ride app to join a ride. The page asks riders to become members and doesn't say whether a first ride is free. Pick the group by lap time. The club also runs Prospect Park laps on Tuesday and Thursday mornings.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:05 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 22 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Weekday Dawn Laps in Central Park (NYCC) group ride

The New York Cycle Club's before-work laps of Central Park, Monday to Thursday. Groups start from 5:40 to 6:50 am and split by lap time, from fast A groups to a slow C group. Riders go two to four laps in a rotating paceline, in pacelines of fewer than ten.
